Manager of Party Instance Zones Benusta:
Have you heard of the Canon Cathedral, the blessed sanctuary of Einhasad?
Something strange is happening there of late. There are rumors that are hard to believe. Please help us find out the truth.
On entering the instance zone, you need to select a difficulty level. After you've made your choice, the entry will be limited until 6:30 regardless of the results.
Party members may re-enter the instance zone during the battle, but if all of them leave the zone, they need to return within 1 minute.
